From: carol@company.com
To: security@company.com
Subject: Security review for database credentials
Date: 2025-07-20

Team,

I've been reviewing how we handle database credentials in the
Pocket Advisor deployment. Currently, passwords are stored in
workspaces/pocket-advisor-infra.yaml with ${VAR} placeholders
that get expanded from the environment.

This approach works for local development but has issues:
1. The .envrc file must be kept secure
2. No rotation mechanism exists
3. Audit trail is limited

I recommend we implement:
- Automatic credential rotation via Kubernetes operator
- Integration with external secret management (Vault, AWS Secrets Manager)
- Enhanced audit logging for credential access

Please review and provide feedback by end of week.

Thanks,
Carol
